g.text: Iranian Persian: 394 of 495 papers (80%). Pashto (51M) has 29, Balochi (9M) has 4.
2 · The gap starts below the papers
Little or no web text, dictionary entries, UniMorph paradigms or tools for most varieties; under 40K parallel pairs.
3 · Labels and scripts are part of the problem
Macrolanguage codes, contested dialect status and inconsistent Unicode hide varieties from pipelines.
4 · Persian needs new tests, the rest need first tests
Persian is saturating on standard tasks; cultural and pragmatic competence is open.
Tagged web text, FLORES+ sentences, one native benchmark per variety.
